objective: Expose canonical insurance lead operating-state controls inside the existing private River OS CRM relationship workspace without creating a second CRM mutation path.

insuranceControls.visibleOnlyWhen: The canonical relationship has a matching InsuranceLeadPresentation.
insuranceControls.assignment: Blank assignedProducer explicitly targets unassigned state.
insuranceControls.submit: One explicit Save insurance operating state action; no automatic mutation.

singleStageMutationPath.insuranceRelationships: Generic CRM update form submits current stage as a hidden value so it cannot independently mutate the stage.
singleStageMutationPath.nonInsuranceRelationships: Existing generic CRM Stage selector remains unchanged.
singleStageMutationPath.authority: Insurance stage mutation flows only through INS-006U -> INS-006S -> INS-006Q.
